receipt_correction: A separately versioned exact D5/D10 Euler-node validator replaces the old D2/D10-only receipt helper; sampler, camera arithmetic, conditions, tolerance and research gates are unchanged. New GPU gates also check node receipts on every finite-bank policy request.
technical_correction: Batch1 reuses unmodified native batch2 two-part projection kernels with seq_len256, preserving BF16 partial-rounding order. The failed generic-batch1 implementation and its records remain unchanged. All same1e-5 gates must pass; no quality episodes from v1 exist.
hypothesis: External-view and wrist-view freshness may matter differently across task suites; no measured preference assumed.
proposal_basis: The completed module branch produced two usable paths but AE16 was no worse in every suite. Camera branches now change the information refreshed, at equal nominal and measured cost.

design.Full: D10,27-layer vision for both views,VLM18,AE18 on every Full request
design.Fast: D5,VLM18,AE18; one camera runs native27-layer vision, the other holds raw features from its own most recent Full
design.both_fresh_control: D5 and same refresh schedule, both native camera views recomputed on every Fast; excluded from primary pair selection
design.motivation: D5 protects action-generation quality while four Fast requests expose camera-specific freshness over5/10/15/20 executed actions. This is an exploratory design choice, not a previously measured improvement.
design.cache: Periodic paths clone raw pre-projector two-view features at each own Full; hold only the other view; never update cache from Fast, another condition, prompt or episode. The always-Full baseline creates no unused feature cache.
design.implementation: Native num_views argument is unused. Real input/scratch tensors use batch1; original native kernels and the released batch2 projection arithmetic are retained with seq_len256; camera0=agentview,camera1=wrist.

calibration.required: Native unwrapped D5/D10 vs AE18-wrapped parity; actual AE18 visits/NFE; real vision batch1; same-observation raw/prefix/action parity; nontrivial mixed-view oracle raw/prefix/action parity; own-Full cache age and reset; four Full trajectories bitwise bridge preserved Full.
calibration.profile: All four configurations on four original bank prompts,10 warmup and20 measured requests each; whole five-request cycles.

discovery.reference_scope: Original Full records/manifests and receipts retain identities. These80 known cases are exploratory controls, not80 new replications. Reuse requires accepted numeric/trajectory/physical-input bridge.
discovery.pair_eligibility: Only agent_fresh_d5/wrist_fresh_d5; both overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15; each median completed-service native cost ratio>=1.15; measured pair mean-cycle cost within10%; opposite distinct-suite gaps>=.10, >=2 positive tasks and every task leave-one-out positive.
discovery.ranking: Maximum minimum directional gap, sum gaps, minimum overall successes, then lexical path/suite ids. Freeze directions only after all240 new and80 preserved cells accepted.

confirmation.primary: One-sided exact ten-task sign-flip including ties, Holm2 across exactly two frozen directions
confirmation.verdict: Both directions positive; each Holm2 p<.05, whole-task bootstrap lower>0 and every task LOO positive; both paths>=.75 and>=Full-.15; each native cost ratio>=1.15 and pair within10%.

limits: Suite-conditioned periodic camera-path evidence only; no semantic-category generality, no within-task phase claim, no standalone path-quality or adaptive-choice benefit established. Shared GPU timing is descriptive; multiple exploratory branches do not imply study-wide5% error control.
no_candidate: Preserve the bounded negative result; do not launch confirmation, weaken gates or reinterpret the both-fresh control as the prespecified camera pair. Continue the overall goal in a separately specified branch.
